title: Festbiss – Video-Ad 15 (DE) · „Deutscher vs. italienischer Zahnarzt“ – Debatte (Variante B)
format: Photoreal debate on a dark interview stage: two dentists sit on wooden chairs facing each other under spotlights (wide, medium and close shots), intercut with a denture wearer at restaurant tables, in the bathroom and in her kitchen, one lab shot, 3D cross-section models of the jaw ridge on a slate-blue background and a product shot in the spotlight.
voice_note: Two male voices: the German dentist (deep, sceptical, by-the-book) and the Italian dentist (calm, warm, light Italian accent); a neutral narrator for the first line. They address each other with Sie; the Italian addresses the viewer with Sie in the CTA.
captions_note: White bold sans with a soft black shadow, 2–5 words, centered in the lower middle. S01: red header boxes with white text at the top. Green round 60-day badge right of center from S48.
